title: Sunday · the Grunion Run, 2008
logline: The run from the dunes above: the lanterns a broken line down the sand, the fish a silver seam, and in the last tier the seam gone and the lanterns going home.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach from the dune grass at night, lanterns in a broken line.

panels.name: Above

panels.composition: Tier 2: the surf line a silver seam of fish, tiny figures bent at it.

panels.name: Seam

panels.composition: Tier 3: the seam gone, lanterns strung up the beach path going home.
